description.zh: 要查询的申请批次ID。申请批次ID可在[BatchRegisterDeviceWithApplyId](~~69514~~)和[BatchRegisterDevice](~~69473~~)接口返回结果中查看。
description.en: The ID of the application. You can view the application ID in the response of the [BatchRegisterDeviceWithApplyId](~~69514~~) or [BatchRegisterDevice](~~69473~~) operation.

description.zh: 指定从返回结果中的第几页开始显示。默认值是1。
description.en: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1.

description.zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无<props="intl"><ph>**实例概览**页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。
description.en:
The ID of the instance. You can view the instance **ID** on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

>*   If your instance has an ID, you must configure this parameter. If you do not set this parameter, the call fails.
>*   If your instance has no **Overview** page or ID, you do not need to set this parameter.

For more information, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

description.zh: 指定返回结果中每页显示的记录数量。数量限制：每页最多可显示50条。默认值是10。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10.

title.zh: 查询批量注册的设备信息

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制

单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为50。
 > RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Limits

Each Alibaba Cloud account can run a maximum of 50 queries per second (QPS).

>  RAM users of an Alibaba Cloud account share the quota of the account.
